scope: Saved valid training responses only; generated-token denominators, not prompt/padding.

credit_settings.matching: same-class maximum-total-IoU one-to-one; strictly positive IoU; dummy unmatched assignments
credit_settings.matched_credit: matched IoU minus mean quality for the same GT over all eight responses; missing quality is zero; no standard-deviation scaling
credit_settings.class_stop_credit: negative unmatched-GT fraction within the class, at its last actually generated box_end
credit_settings.eos_credit: negative missing-GT count from entirely absent classes divided by all evaluable GT, at an actually generated terminal EOS
credit_settings.initialization: same original-ID SFT adapter as the global-reward baseline; never initialize from the RL baseline

loss_gradient_probe.limitation: Installed loss core, real saved responses/advantages; controlled IS=1 logps, not historical model gradients.
